title: Great figures he met said we are not alone

tellings.quote: You know these kinds of minds, the greatest minds, real geniuses, all of them said we are not alone.

plain: A man introduced on the show as a former president of a Russian republic says that the greatest minds he has met, "real geniuses", all told him "we are not alone". He names among them Pope John Paul II, the Dalai Lama, the Bulgarian seer Baba Vanga, the Indian guru Sai Baba, Henry Kissinger and the physicist Zhores Alferov. He tells Michels this from his own meetings, as weight for his view that humans share the universe with other beings.
